title: Activated switching between coexisting limit cycles
summary: Noise-activated switching between coexisting stable states is a fundamental mechanism underlying stochastic dynamics in systems ranging from chemical reactions to neural networks. While this phenomenon is well understood for stationary attractors, it remains largely unexplored for limit cycles, whose periodic motion cannot be described by a static potential landscape. Here we experimentally demonstrate activated switching between two coexisting limit-cycle attractors in a driven nonlinear system of coupled resonators.
